info.title: C TWO
info.description: C TWO is an Agentic Management Platform that orchestrates automation workflows, manages human-robot interactions, and processes work items through universal queues. Use this connector to trigger flows from C TWO sessions, manage session lifecycle, create and process queue items, and enable human-in-the-loop interactions with digital workers.

get.description: Retrieves the list of C TWO tasks that are configured and ready to be triggered. This internal operation is used to populate dynamic dropdowns in other actions.

sessions.description: Set of sessions triggered by C TWO without timeout

post.summary: Start Flow from Session Request without Timeout

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: Select the C TWO task that will trigger this flow. When a new session is created for this task in C TWO, the flow will start automatically without enforcing a timeout.

post.description: Polls for new C TWO sessions and triggers the flow when a session is created for the selected task. Use this trigger when the automation does not require a timeout constraint. The flow receives session details including input values passed from C TWO.

sessions.description: Set of sessions triggered by C TWO with timeout

post.summary: Start Flow from Session Request with Timeout

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: Select the C TWO task that will trigger this flow. When a session is created for this task, the flow starts with the specified timeout enforced.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Maximum time in seconds that the session is allowed to run before C TWO marks it as timed out.

post.description: Polls for new C TWO sessions and triggers the flow with a timeout constraint. Use this trigger when the automation must complete within a specific time window. If the session exceeds the timeout, C TWO will handle it according to its timeout policy.

post.summary: Set Flow Execution State to Completed

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The C TWO session ID to mark as successfully completed. Defaults to the session ID from the trigger output.

post.description: Marks a C TWO session as completed, signaling that the flow has finished its work successfully. Place this action at the end of your flow to report back to C TWO that the automation completed without errors.

post.summary: Set Flow Execution State to Failed
post.description: Marks a C TWO session as failed, signaling that an error occurred during flow execution. Use this action in error-handling scopes to report failures back to C TWO with details about what went wrong.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The C TWO session ID to mark as failed. Defaults to the session ID from the trigger output.

details.description: A description of the error or exception that caused the session to fail.
details.title: details

post.description: Writes a log entry to a C TWO session. Use this action to track progress, record decisions, or log diagnostic information during flow execution. Logs are visible in the C TWO platform for auditing and troubleshooting.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The C TWO session ID where the log entry will be recorded. Defaults to the session ID from the trigger output.

level.description: The severity level of the log entry.

message.description: The log message content to record.

post.description: Updates the timeout value for an active C TWO session. Use this action to extend or reduce the allowed execution time for a running session when the original timeout needs adjustment.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The C TWO session ID to update the timeout for. Defaults to the session ID from the trigger output.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The new timeout value in seconds to apply to the session.

get.description: Checks whether C TWO has requested a graceful (soft) stop for the given session. Use this action inside loops to periodically check if the session should terminate early, allowing the flow to clean up resources before stopping.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The C TWO session ID to check for a stop request. Defaults to the session ID from the trigger output.

post.description: Creates a new robot interaction form that allows a digital worker to request human assistance. The form is presented to assigned users in the C TWO platform, enabling human-in-the-loop scenarios where human expertise is needed to handle exceptions or complex decisions.

fields.description: JSON-formatted string defining the form fields that the human user needs to fill in.

title.description: The title displayed to the human user when they open the form.

deadline.description: The deadline by which the human must respond to the form (ISO 8601 format).

intro.description: Introductory text shown to the human user explaining what action is needed.

itemId.description: The queue item ID associated with this form, linking the human interaction to a specific work item.

workflowTaskId.description: The C TWO task that created this form.

patch.description: Assigns a robot interaction form to a specific user, making them responsible for reviewing and completing the human-in-the-loop request.

parameters.name: formId
parameters.description: Human in the loop form id to assign.

userId.description: The ID of the user to assign the form to.

patch.description: Removes the current user assignment from a robot interaction form, making it available for other users to claim.

parameters.name: formId
parameters.description: Human in the loop form id to unassign.

patch.description: Marks a robot interaction form as completed, signaling that the human user has provided the requested input and the digital worker can resume processing.

parameters.name: formId
parameters.description: Human in the loop form id to mark as completed.

completedAt.description: The timestamp when the form was completed (ISO 8601 format).

get.description: Retrieves a list of robot interaction forms with optional filtering. Use this action to query pending human-in-the-loop requests, check their status, or find forms assigned to specific users.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Number of records to return.

parameters.name: deadlineBefore
parameters.description: Filter forms with a deadline before this date/time (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: deadlineAfter
parameters.description: Filter forms with a deadline after this date/time (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: includeCompleted
parameters.description: Whether to include completed forms in the results.

parameters.name: claimedByUserId
parameters.description: Filter forms claimed by a specific user ID.

parameters.name: createdByWorkflowTaskId
parameters.description: Filter forms created by a specific workflow task ID.

get.description: Retrieves the list of tasks configured in the C TWO platform. This internal operation is used to populate dynamic dropdowns for task selection in other actions.

id.description: The unique identifier of the queue item.

itemKey.description: The unique key of the queue item.

queueId.description: The identifier of the parent queue.

state.description: The current state of the queue item.

tags.description: The tags associated with the queue item.

createdByVendorSessionId.description: The session ID that created this item.

test.description: Whether this is a test item.

get.description: Retrieves queue items based on specified filter criteria such as state, tags, dates, and queue names. Use this action to search for and monitor work items across your universal queues.

parameters.name: itemKey
parameters.description: Filter by item key.

parameters.name: attempts
parameters.description: Filter by number of attempts.

parameters.name: deferredBefore
parameters.description: Filter items deferred before this date.

parameters.name: deferredAfter
parameters.description: Filter items deferred after this date.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Filter items created before this date.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Filter items created after this date.

parameters.name: concludedBefore
parameters.description: Filter items concluded before this date.

parameters.name: concludedAfter
parameters.description: Filter items concluded after this date.

parameters.name: stateEnteredTimeBefore
parameters.description: Filter items that entered state before this time.

parameters.name: stateEnteredTimeAfter
parameters.description: Filter items that entered state after this time.

parameters.name: states
parameters.description: Filter by queue item state.

parameters.name: queueItemStateIds
parameters.description: Filter by queue item state IDs.

parameters.name: queueItemStateNames
parameters.description: Filter by queue item state names.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Filter by tags (comma-separated).

parameters.name: queueIds
parameters.description: Filter by queue IDs.

parameters.name: queueNames
parameters.description: Filter by queue names (required).

parameters.name: references
parameters.description: Filter by queue references.

parameters.name: includeItemData
parameters.description: Whether to include item data in response.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Number of records to return.

post.description: Creates a new work item in a specified universal queue. Use this action to add items for processing by digital workers, including data payloads, tags, and optional file attachments.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The queue item details to create.

itemKey.description: A unique business key to identify this queue item (e.g., invoice number, case ID).
itemKey.title: Item Key

queueItemState.description: The initial state of the queue item (e.g., Pending).
queueItemState.title: Queue Item State

reference.description: The queue reference where the item will be created.
reference.title: Queue Reference

deferredUntil.description: Defer processing until this date/time (ISO 8601 format).
deferredUntil.title: Deferred Until

itemData.description: The data payload for the queue item in JSON format.
itemData.title: Item Data

fileName.description: The name of the attachment file.

attachments.description: File attachments for the queue item.
attachments.title: Attachments

sessionId.description: The session ID associated with this item.
sessionId.title: Session ID

device.description: The device that created this item.
device.title: Device

user.description: The user who created this item.
user.title: User

automationProvider.description: The automation provider for this item.
automationProvider.title: Automation Provider

id.description: The unique identifier of the locked item.

itemKey.description: The unique key of the locked item.

queueId.description: The identifier of the parent queue.

state.description: The current state of the queue item.

tags.description: The tags associated with the queue item.

createdByVendorSessionId.description: The session ID that created this item.

test.description: Whether this is a test item.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The lock request details.

queueItemId.description: The ID of the queue item to lock. If omitted, the next available item matching the filter will be locked.
queueItemId.title: Queue Item ID

reference.description: The queue reference to lock an item from.
reference.title: Queue Name

stateId.description: The state ID to filter items.
stateId.title: State ID

stateName.description: The state name to filter items by.
stateName.title: State Name

sessionId.description: The session ID for this lock.
sessionId.title: Session ID

automationProvider.description: The automation provider performing the lock.
automationProvider.title: Automation Provider

test.description: Whether this is a test lock.
test.title: Test

patch.description: Locks a queue item to prevent other workers from processing it concurrently. Use this action before processing a work item to ensure exclusive access.
Defers a queue item so it will not be processed until the specified date/time. Use this action when an item cannot be processed now but should be retried later.

parameters.name: queueItemId
parameters.description: The ID of the queue item to defer.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The defer details.

deferredUntil.description: The date/time to defer until (ISO 8601 format).
deferredUntil.title: Deferred Until

post.description: Updates the data content of a queue item. Use this action to modify the payload of a work item during processing, for example to store intermediate results.

parameters.name: queueItemId
parameters.description: The ID of the queue item to update.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The new data for the queue item.

data.description: The new data payload for the queue item, as a JSON object.
data.title: Data

created.description: The creation timestamp for this data.
created.title: Created

patch.description: Unlocks a previously locked queue item and returns it to its available state. Use this action when processing is interrupted and the item should be released for other workers.

parameters.name: queueItemId
parameters.description: The ID of the queue item to unlock.

post.description: Changes the state of a queue item (e.g., from Pending to Completed, or to a custom state). Use this action to advance items through your workflow pipeline.

parameters.name: queueItemId
parameters.description: The ID of the queue item to update.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The new state information.

state.description: The new state for the queue item.
state.title: State

patch.description: Retry a specific queue item, setting its data back to its original value and creating a new Attempt.

parameters.name: queueItemId
parameters.description: Specific queue item id to retry.

parameters.name: stateId
parameters.description: Specific pending queue item state id to be set; takes priority over state parameter.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Specific pending queue item state name to be set.

parameters.name: workflowTaskId
parameters.description: WorkflowTask identifier.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: App identifier.

post.description: Adds a log message to a queue item for audit trail and traceability. Use this action to record processing steps, warnings, or errors against a specific work item.

parameters.name: queueItemId
parameters.description: The ID of the queue item to log to.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The log message details.

level.description: The severity level of the log entry.
level.title: Log Level

delete.description: Removes one or more tags from a queue item. Use this action to update the categorization of work items during processing.

parameters.name: queueItemId
parameters.description: The ID of the queue item to remove tags from.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of tags to remove.

patch.description: Adds one or more tags to a queue item for categorization and filtering. Tags help organize and search for work items across queues.

parameters.name: queueItemId
parameters.description: The ID of the queue item to add tags to.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The tags to add.

tags.description: Comma-separated list of tags to add.
tags.title: Tags

get.description: Retrieves a specific file attachment from a queue item as base64-encoded data. Use this action to download files that were attached to work items during creation or processing.

parameters.name: queueItemId
parameters.description: The ID of the queue item containing the attachment.

parameters.name: attachmentId
parameters.description: The ID of the attachment to retrieve.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The filename of the attachment.

post.description: Creates a new custom state within a specific queue. Custom states allow you to define workflow stages beyond the default states (Pending, Completed, Referred), tailoring the queue to your business process.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The state configuration details.

name.description: The name of the new state.
name.title: Name

responseTimeCalculationBasis.description: Determines how response time SLAs are calculated for items entering this state.
responseTimeCalculationBasis.title: Response Time Calculation

state.description: The type of state (Pending, Completed, or Referred).
state.title: State Type

queueId.description: The ID of the queue where this state will be created.
queueId.title: Queue ID

description.description: A description of what this state represents in your workflow.
description.title: Description

timeSavedPerItem.description: Time saved per item in this state (seconds), used for ROI reporting.
timeSavedPerItem.title: Time Saved Per Item

valueGeneratedPerItem.description: Value generated per item in this state, used for ROI reporting.
valueGeneratedPerItem.title: Value Generated Per Item

includeInReports.description: Whether to include this state in analytics and reports.
includeInReports.title: Include In Reports

id.description: The unique identifier of the queue.

tagfilter.description: The tag filter for this state.

states.description: The states available in this queue.

get.description: Retrieves universal queues based on filter criteria. Use this action to list available queues, check their configuration, or look up queue details. This operation also powers dynamic dropdowns in other actions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Filter by queue ID.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Filter by queue reference.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filter by queue name.

parameters.name: stateName
parameters.description: Filter by state name.

parameters.name: deleted
parameters.description: Filter by deleted status.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Number of records to return.

get.description: Retrieves a specific robot interaction form by its unique identifier. Use this action to fetch the details, fields, and current status of a human-in-the-loop form that was created by a digital worker.

parameters.name: formId
parameters.description: Human in the loop form id to get details.

get.description: Returns filtered users and service accounts.
